Home / Handy Features That Change Your Every Day
Handy Features

Handy features that change your every day.

Comment detection, a timer, notifications, offline support, and more — small features that make a real difference every day.

💬

Automatic New-Comment Detection

Comments that arrived since your last check are automatically pulled to the top of the list

⏱

Time Tracking

Track your work time with a single button. Reflected in Backlog's actual hours when you stop

💤

Snooze

Temporarily hide it from the list, badge, and notifications until a date you choose

🔔

Rich Notifications

Choose desktop due-date notifications every time or once a day. Includes an unread-mentions badge plus Slack/Teams webhook integration

📴

Offline Support

Changes made while offline are queued and sent automatically once you're back online

🌛

Dark Mode

Switch between light and dark. Also follows your OS setting automatically

Even more convenient

What's newly possible

📌

A persistent tab on your Backlog page

Open and close it as a full-screen overlay from the tab on the right edge of the page

📝

Daily & Weekly Report Drafts

Automatically generates a draft from completed, in-progress, and overdue tasks — just copy it as is

🏥

Project Health Score

Automatically scored from 0 to 100 based on overdue rate, stalled task count, and assignee imbalance. Includes a 30-day trend sparkline

🐢

Follow-Up Task Detection

Lists incomplete tasks due within a week. Same inline editing as All Tasks, plus one-click follow-up comments

🔀

Automatic Schedule Shifting for Dependencies

Change a predecessor task's due date on the Gantt chart, and downstream tasks shift automatically after confirmation

📆

Weekly Retrospective Report

Shows this week's completed, new, carried-over, and on-time rate as KPI cards and graphs compared to last week

Toward days where nothing gets missed.

New comments and deadlines — you'll know before they become a problem.

Backlog My Tasks

A Chrome extension that lets you check and manage all your assigned Backlog tasks across multiple spaces in one place. With 7 display views and a Project Dashboard, everyday task management and tracking team progress become effortless.
